    """Return maximal straight horizontal/vertical/diagonal runs of non-bg cells as cell lists."""

def components(g, bg):
    """4-connected non-bg components: list of (color, size, bbox, cells)."""
    R, C = len(g), len(g[0])
    seen = [[False] * C for _ in range(R)]
    out = []
    for i in range(R):
        for j in range(C):
            if g[i][j] != bg and not seen[i][j]:
                colr = g[i][j]
                stack = [(i, j)]
                seen[i][j] = True
                cells = []
                while stack:
                    r, c = stack.pop()
                    cells.append((r, c))
                    for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
                        for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
                            r2, c2 = r + dr, c + dc
                            if 0 <= r2 < R and 0 <= c2 < C and not seen[r2][c2] and g[r2][c2] == colr:
                                seen[r2][c2] = True
                                stack.append((r2, c2))
                rs = [r for r, c in cells]; cs = [c for r, c in cells]
                out.append((colr, len(cells), (min(rs), min(cs), max(rs), max(cs)), cells))
    return out


def find_L_line(comps):
    """Find the unique 1-thick L-shaped line component; returns (cells, corner, dv, dh, color)."""
    for colr, size, bb, cl in comps:
        cs = set(cl)
        for (i, j) in cs:
            for dv, dh in [(-1, 1), (-1, -1), (1, 1), (1, -1)]:
                if all(c == j or r == i for r, c in cs) and \\
                   all((r - i) * dv >= 0 for r, c in cs if c == j) and \\

    return None
